title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. Live starts are counted from 1 October 2026 for v005 and from 9 October 2026 for v006. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper. The record also notes a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. That entry is paper, and no exit is recorded for it in the facts above. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, so its outcome is not yet measured; no exit price or percentage is recorded for it. With 0 positions open on paper across the engines listed, there is no open paper exposure in those engine records at the snapshot. A single trade says nothing about a strategy, and an open position is not a result.

## Closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 6, average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 7, average -13.34% net per trade. The ATOM trade is the named closed trade: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, exit below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, result −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule was an exit below the 10-day low; the measurement was the exit price at 1.703; the result was −17.9% after costs. The trend engine averages are negative over the closed counts shown. The htf-rsi-v007 average is null net per trade over 4 closed trades, so no signed average percentage is reported for that engine. These are paper results, not evidence of future performance.

## Market filter

trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off. trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off. Both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper at the snapshot. The filter state is reported as off; the record does not state a further rule effect beyond that. No position is open in either trend engine, and the closed trade averages for those engines are -13.22% and -13.34% over 6 and 7 trades. The filter being off is reported alongside 0 open positions; the record does not say whether the filter will change, and no prediction follows from that state. This is the current state, not a forecast.

## Distance to 20-day breakout

For a 20-day breakout entry, price must clear the prior 20-day high. The percentages below are distance from that trigger: a smaller percentage is closer, a larger percentage is farther away. trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: TRXUSDT is 12.91% below its high; AVAXUSDT is 21.13% below its high; XLMUSDT is 21.40% below its high. trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: JUPUSDT is 12.39% below its high; TRXUSDT is 12.91% below its high; AVAXUSDT is 21.13% below its high. These names are the closest to their 20-day breakout among the reported list; being closest does not mean a breakout has occurred or will occur. These are measurements of distance, not signals or recommendations.

## Where to check

The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This article reports the live record as it stands, in plain language, with no projection. No number in this article is estimated or rounded; each is taken from the live record.
